messages:
zeke: quick note from infra: quota ledger will start accepting `X-RW-Route-Policy` only in 2 weeks. we need SDKs to stop sending `X-Route-Hint` by then or ledger will treat as unlabeled requests.

mina: ugh. we just shipped a minor release that still sets x-route-hint for some codepaths.

rana: can we do feature detection at runtime? e.g., SDK pings ledger health endpoint and if returns support=true then switch to new header only?

kevin: risky. health endpoints are rate-limited and may not reflect global rollout. prefer phase: canary releases -> platform dual-write -> sdk default switch.

zeke: understood. but ledger will also log unlabeled spikes if clients don't upgrade fast enough. ops will escalate.

mina: i'm going to carve a patch release and patch the old codepath to emit both headers. will ship today.

deploy-bot: patch release queued for sdk-go @ 1745552300

deploy-bot: sdk-go-patch published -> 1.9.3

kevin: thanks. we'll still push the longer migration plan. add to release notes: 'compat: emits legacy header for 2 releases when RW_HEADER_MODE=stable'.

rana: can we add a toggle in console to backfill unlabeled requests by heuristics? not ideal but could cushion the landing.

zeke: we'll evaluate but prefer client fixes.

mina: creating PRs now.
